<thought>The spectrum shows a dominant peak at m/z ≈ 100 with a series of much smaller peaks at +1, +2, +3 Da etc., decreasing rapidly in intensity. No characteristic 2 Da pattern of chlorine (≈ 1/3 intensity) or bromine (≈ 1:1 intensity) is present, and the relative intensities do not match the known isotope ratios of sulfur, silicon, or other common elements. Therefore, from the observed isotopic distribution we cannot definitively identify any specific element.</thought>
